headerDisplay: Exposes TCL Home split air conditioners (e.g. BreezeIN 2.0) as single Apple-like HeaterCooler accessories. Sign in with the same credentials you use in the TCL Home app — your region is discovered automatically from your account, exactly like the app does.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the AC state from the TCL cloud.

enableDehumidifier.title: Expose Dry mode as a separate Dehumidifier accessory
enableDehumidifier.description: Adds a second tile per AC controlling the unit's Dry mode. The humidity reading shown by the Home app is a fixed 50% — TCL split ACs have no humidity sensor.

devices.title: Device allowlist (optional)
devices.description: Leave empty to expose every split AC on the account. Add TCL device IDs to expose only specific units (IDs are printed in the Homebridge log at startup).

iotEndpoint.title: AWS IoT endpoint override
iotEndpoint.description: Normally auto-discovered. Only set if shadow reads fail.

enabled.title: Regulate on a room sensor from the Home app
enabled.description: Sends the AC a corrected target so the room, as measured by a Home app sensor, reaches your target. Adds a 'Sensor poll' switch and needs a Home automation: see the README.

token.title: Token
token.description: Shared secret your shortcut sends in the x-token header. At least 16 characters.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: One entry per AC to compensate. Device IDs are printed in the log at startup.

roomKey.title: Room key used in the shortcut

logReadings.title: Log every temperature push
logReadings.description: Writes each reading the Home automation sends to the Homebridge log. Without it, only the first push after a restart is logged.

bindHost.title: Listen address
bindHost.description: Optional. The LAN IP of the Homebridge host, to listen on that interface only.

items.helpvalue:
One-time setup in the Home app (after saving and restarting):

  1. A Sensor poll switch appears. Put it in a room you don't use and leave it out of favourites.
  2. Automation tab → + → An Accessory is Controlled → Sensor poll → Turns On. On the actions screen choose Convert to Shortcut.
  3. For each room, add Get the state of → the room's sensor → Current Temperature.
  4. Add Get Contents of URL:
    • URL: http://<Homebridge IP>:18581/temperatures. That is the address you open this UI with, but on port 18581 (or the port set below) and with /temperatures. The Homebridge log prints this URL and all the settings below at startup.
    • Method POST; Headers: x-token = the token above.
    • Request Body JSON: add a field readings of type Dictionary, and inside it one field per room: the room key from the list above → that room's Current Temperature.
  5. Never include the ACs' own Current Temperature.
  6. Test by tapping Sensor poll: within about 15 seconds the AC tiles show the room temperatures, and the log shows the first push after each restart (tick Log every temperature push to see every one) or a warning that says what is wrong.
